found: The HCMUNRE capstone format guide contains official review prompts concerning structure/method, theory, application and achieved results; it does not supply scored performance levels or weights in that review section. The second asset is a capstone proposal-outline template. The LMS capture guide is content/capture guidance, not an official scoring rubric.
applicability: HCMUNRE review prompts are not applied to the LMS course essay because the direct user instruction borrows style only. No HCMUNRE affiliation is asserted.
